source: real Git in this checkout (not shallow; objects via .git/objects/info/alternates): git log, git show, git diff, git rev-parse, git archive through scripts/referee/history.mjs
triagedBy: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-11-23 America/Los_Angeles. Supersedes the 2026-11-22 Kiro read-only triage, whose commit ids were all confirmed with git log --no-walk.

statuses.sealed: blind input and sealed answer exist in proof/history and verify passes (none)
statuses.candidate-unsupported: a real engine defect, but its observable is outside the referee's normalized state schema
statuses.replayed-no-state-difference: the blind input was replayed on the frozen referee and both archived revisions; every judged state pointer agrees
statuses.excluded-rule-revision: a deliberate rules change (new card, keyword or action), not a correction; the old expectation was right under the rules of its time
statuses.excluded-bot-policy: changes only how the CPU chooses moves; applyAction results are unchanged
statuses.excluded-reporting-only: changes only an emitted event field; state after every action is unchanged
statuses.excluded-boss-scope: bounty, boss or arrival modifiers, outside standard single duels
statuses.excluded-not-a-fix: feature, refactor, presentation or hook commit with no duel-rules defect in its diff
statuses.excluded-lane: the retired lane duel engine, not Showdown
statuses.excluded-not-rules-test: a test file the miner watches, but the changed tests are not about duel rules
